title: Certificates of Deposit: jumbo and relationship bonus schedule by tier
content:
## Scope

This schedule covers the two rate bonuses of the Certificates of Deposit line, the jumbo bonus and the relationship bonus, and states for every tier whether each is offered, at what principal the jumbo bonus starts, how many percentage points each adds, which checking tiers qualify for the relationship bonus, and whether the relationship bonus is looked at again at each renewal.

## Definitions

- **Jumbo bonus offered** states whether the jumbo bonus is offered on the tier at all.
- **Jumbo threshold** is the principal at term start, in USD, at or above which the jumbo bonus applies.
- **Jumbo bonus points** are the percentage points added to both the interest rate and the APY when the jumbo bonus applies.
- **Relationship bonus points** are the percentage points added to both the interest rate and the APY when the relationship bonus applies.
- **Qualifying checking tiers** are the official checking tiers whose active holding at term start earns the relationship bonus.
- **Relationship bonus re-evaluated on renewal** states whether the relationship bonus is re-evaluated, and may be earned, at each renewal.

## Jumbo bonus by tier

| Tier | Jumbo bonus offered | Jumbo threshold (USD, principal at term start) | Jumbo bonus points |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | Yes | 100000.00 | 0.10 |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | No | 100000.00 | 0.00 |
| 12-Month Certificate | Yes | 100000.00 | 0.10 |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | Yes | 100000.00 | 0.10 |
| 36-Month Certificate | Yes | 100000.00 | 0.10 |
| 60-Month Certificate | Yes | 100000.00 | 0.10 |

## Relationship bonus by tier

| Tier | Relationship bonus points | Qualifying checking tiers | Re-evaluated at each renewal |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | 0.10 | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | Yes |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 0.05 | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | Yes |
| 12-Month Certificate | 0.15 | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | Yes |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 0.15 | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | Yes |
| 36-Month Certificate | 0.20 | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | Yes |
| 60-Month Certificate | 0.20 | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | Yes |

## Points of judgement

**The 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate lists a jumbo threshold. Does a large deposit earn the jumbo bonus there?**
No. The jumbo bonus is not offered on that tier, and its jumbo bonus points are 0.00, so the threshold figure has no effect on it.

**Is a principal exactly at the threshold enough?**
Yes. The threshold is the principal "at or above which" the jumbo bonus applies. On a tier that offers the bonus, a principal at term start of exactly 100000.00 USD qualifies; a principal of 99999.99 USD does not.

**A customer's checking account is an Interest Checking account. Which tiers can earn the relationship bonus from it?**
Every tier except the 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate, whose qualifying checking tiers are limited to Premier Checking and Private Client Checking.

**Which tiers pay the largest relationship bonus?**
The 36-Month Certificate and the 60-Month Certificate, at 0.20 percentage points each. The smallest is the 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate, at 0.05.

**Where do the bonus points go?**
Each bonus is stated as percentage points that are added to both the interest rate and the APY of the certificate, not to only one of them.
